title: Read an existing configuration state
prompt: Check config-status.txt and confirm whether the workspace is already marked ready. Do not change the file.

title: Repair a missing local configuration file
prompt: Run repair-check.ps1. If the local configuration is incomplete, repair the workspace so the check succeeds, then verify the check again.

title: Run a slower deterministic verification
prompt: Run verify-package.ps1 and report whether the supplied package data passes its verification. Do not edit the package data.

files.verify-package.ps1:
$expected = '4FDBC441EA7B546100E086AC1E4FC5AE6749B7314311C99DB05BE450ECA12996'
Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
$actual = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath './package-data.txt').Hash
if ($actual -eq $expected) { Write-Output 'CAL_SLOW_OK'; exit 0 }
Write-Output 'CAL_SLOW_FAIL'; exit 5
